qa_pair.question: Using only the two pre-approved fixture window grants, inspect both accessibility trees. Which window contains the group that combines identity, environment, notifications, and confidence controls? Return the final title word only.

Inspect both fixture windows and count all interactive controls: text and secure fields, checkboxes, popups, sliders, and buttons, while excluding groups and static text. Return the total as an integer.

Inspect the ordinary identity field and the credential-style field in the primary fixture, then verify the inspector state has no credential value either. Does any returned accessibility value reveal the passcode? Respond True or False.
Read the selected deployment environment in the primary fixture and confirm the inspector window's immutable build marker is present. Return only the environment value.
Read the numeric counter from the inspector and the fractional confidence value from the primary fixture. Add them and return the exact decimal result.
Across both fixture accessibility trees, count controls whose visible label is exactly “Duplicate action”; distinguish controls by their stable element IDs. Return the count.
Compare the primary status with the inspector's last-action value. Which single word describes the fixture as operational rather than indicating no prior action?
Use the primary fixture's declared logical window dimensions, not PNG byte size or Retina backing pixels. Multiply width by height and return the area in square points as an integer.
Compare the logical widths returned for both pre-approved fixture windows. Return only the final title word of the wider one.
Inspect the notifications control and cross-check that its state is not the inspector's numeric counter. Is notifications enabled? Respond True or False.
